newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends barely moved after tight trading.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends barely moved after tight trading.

text.p: The won closed little changed versus the dollar on Wednesday after trading in an extremely narrow range, traders said.
The won ended at an intraday high of 844.70, after opening at 844.80. It hit the bottom at 844.90.
Dealers said a quiet dollar/yen trend on the global market and fears of a possible central bank dollar selling provided strong support for the local currency.
Lack of import deals on Wednesday also kept the dollar buyers sidelined.
But pressure on the won is likely to increase due to large import settlements scheduled for early next week, traders said.
"The dollar is expected to break through 845 unless the central bank comes in strong to stop it," said one dealer.
The base mid-rate is seen at 844.80 for Thursday, compared with 844.60 on Wednesday.
